title: Cái này có hoạt động bên ngoài thành phố không?
englishTitle: Does this work outside the city?
pronunciation: Cai nay co hoat dong ben ngoai thanh pho khong
summary: For checking coverage before a day trip, transfer, or rural stop.

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Before a day trip or transfer, a SIM, data plan, app setup, or service needs to work beyond the city center.

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Show the plan, screen, or item. Ask while there is still time to choose another option.

sections.title: Break it down
sections.body: The phrase asks whether this thing works outside the city; bên ngoài thành phố is the coverage clue.

sections.title: Useful nearby phrases
sections.body: Wi-Fi and SIM basics stay nearby if the answer turns into setup help.

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: Good before buses, tours, long taxis, islands, mountain routes, and hotel moves.

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: Ask about the exact place if you can; outside the city can mean a nearby suburb or a long rural ride.

sections.title: Explore next
sections.body: If the answer is no, battery, charger, data-top-up, and eSIM lines help you recover before leaving.
